name: things
title_zh: macOS 上直接往 Things 3 里塞任务和笔
tagline_zh: 不用打开 Things 就能建项目、加待办、补笔记。适合手在键盘上、脑子在代码里的时刻，一条命令顶五次鼠标点击。
tagline_en: Create projects, tasks, and notes without opening Things. For when your hands are on the keyboard and your head.
desc_en: Use this project's CLI to add, read, and update projects, tasks, and notes in Things 3 on macOS.
why_zh: 它把 Things 3 的 AppleScript 接口包成一套干净 CLI，省去你记脚本语法。
why_en: Wraps Things 3's AppleScript interface into a clean CLI, so you skip scripting syntax. Update tasks, read lists, all from the.
limit_zh: 只认 macOS 上的 Things 3 官方 app，且需已登录 iCloud 同步。不覆盖提醒事项。
limit_en: Requires macOS with Things 3 app and iCloud sync. No Reminders, Calendar, or cross-device push. Output stays in Things; no report export.
title_en: Terminal shortcut to add tasks & notes into Things 3 on.
